passage:
Before the class trip, Mr. Lee gave each student a small paper map. Many students laughed because they had phones.
During the trip, they visited an old town with many narrow streets. After lunch, the internet became weak, and several students could not use their maps online.
Mr. Lee asked everyone to take out the paper maps. At first, the students found them difficult to read. Slowly, they learned to match street names, turn the map, and find the river.
By the end of the day, they reached every place on the plan.
On the bus home, Mr. Lee said, "Technology is useful, but old skills are still tools. A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day."
